title: Sixth Pylon and court
summary: This smaller pylon formed a threshold within the central sanctuary approach.
orientation: Between the Fifth Pylon court and the Palace of Ma’at.

claims.text: This smaller pylon formed a threshold within the central sanctuary approach.
Its court had paired groups of papyrus-form columns and chapels extending east.
Foundation deposits associate the sandstone chapels with the joint reign of Hatshepsut and Thutmose III; this need not mean every chapel was completed then.

citations.locator: About the reconstruction model of Thutmose III

caveats: Field access and demonstration viewpoints are unverified; this is an editorial research draft.
